name: DSH Market
description: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins.

name: DSH Better Sidebar
description: A VSCode-like right sidebar (explorer / editor / terminal / git / browser), isolated per conversation session. Exposes a service for other plugins to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.

name: DSH Rewind
description: In-window conversation rewind that never forks a new session, with a lightweight workspace backup that restores files together with the rewind.

name: DSH-IM
description: Connect IM channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage and more) plus a public AI Office to a local DeepSeek Harness, with bot management in the desktop sidebar.
